entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with David at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I'm calling about an order I received a couple of months ago. I need to process a return for a jersey.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's just the wrong size. I ordered my usual medium, but this model is way too tight across the chest. I was hoping to do an exchange for a large.
Ah, I see. Sizing can definitely be different between collections. I can help with that. Do you have your order number handy?

Thank you. Let me pull that up... Okay, I see the ProFit Jersey, delivered 66 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return policy for standard items. I can approve this return for a full refund right now.

That's great, I appreciate it. Our policy is that you'll get a refund, and then you can place a new order for the correct size. Now, since I have to go through the process of shipping this back and placing a whole new order, would it be possible to get a small discount code for the new jersey? Just to make the whole exchange process a bit smoother.

I understand your perspective. However, our policy for a size-related return is a straightforward refund. We don't provide discount codes for these situations. The good news is you'll get the full amount back to purchase the size that works for you.
I see. I was just thinking a small 10% code would guarantee I re-order from you today. It seems like a fair compromise for the sizing being off from your usual fit.

I'm sorry, but my system doesn't allow for goodwill credits on this type of return. I can generate your pre-paid return label and email it to you immediately, so you can get the process started without any delay. Would that work?
Alright, I had to ask. Yes, please send over the return label. Thank you for your help, David.
You're very welcome. The email with the label is on its way to you now. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
